Presenting with this app

Plug in the projector, press P for Projector Mode, then S to open your notes and timer in a second window on the laptop screen. Most wireless clickers work: they send Page Down and Page Up.

→ Space PgDn
Next slide
← PgUp
Previous slide
Home / End
First or last slide
7 Enter
Type a number, then Enter, to jump to that slide
P
Projector Mode: full screen, no menus, stronger contrast, screen stays awake, click to advance
S
Presenter view: current and next slide, notes, 20-minute pace timer
B or .
Black screen (press again to return)
W
White screen
L
Laser pointer
C
Check the screen: corners, colours and text sizes
G
All slides
N
Speaker notes under the slide (rehearsal)
T
Switch bright room / dark room
Esc
Close this, or leave Projector Mode

Projector tips

Use Bright room when the lights stay on: dark text on a light slide survives a washed-out projector. Use Dark room in a dim hall. If the edges are cut off, choose C to check the corners, then set Text to Smaller. The live rain chart needs internet; without it, the slide shows the saved run from 11 Nov 2026 and says so.
